problem: The plotted fusion curve goes (273.16 K, 0.611 kPa) → (273.17 K, 5000 kPa) → (273.2 K, 22000 kPa). Temperature rises as pressure rises, so the curve leans right. This contradicts the section text ('the fusion curve of water leans left'), the exam trap, the quiz answer and the figure's own aria description. The numbers are also wrong in size: with dp/dT ≈ −13.6 MPa/K, the melting point at 5 MPa is about 272.8 K and at 22 MPa about 271.5 K.
fix: Use points that fall as pressure rises: {'name': 'fus', 'points': [[273.16, 0.611], [272.8, 5000], [271.5, 22000]], ...}. The curve then starts at the triple point and leans left, as the text says.

fix: Keep it once, in the lead only; delete the repeated sentence from Section 1.
